briefdescription.para: Returns the Platform JITDylib, which will contain the ORC runtime (if given) and any platform symbols.

Load a (real) dynamic library and make its symbols available through a new JITDylib with the same name.

detaileddescription.para: If the given executor path contains a valid platform dynamic library then that library will be loaded, and a new bare JITDylib whose name is the given path will be created to make the library's symbols available to JIT'd code.

briefdescription.para: Link a static library into the given JITDylib.

detaileddescription.para: If the given MemoryBuffer contains a valid static archive (or a universal binary with an archive slice that fits the LLJIT instance's platform / architecture) then it will be added to the given JITDylib using a StaticLibraryDefinitionGenerator.

briefdescription.para: Link a static library into the given JITDylib.

detaileddescription.para: If the given host path contains a valid static archive (or a universal binary with an archive slice that fits the LLJIT instance's platform / architecture) then it will be added to the given JITDylib using a StaticLibraryDefinitionGenerator.

briefdescription.para: Create a new JITDylib with the given name and return a reference to it.

detaileddescription.para: JITDylib names must be unique. If the given name is derived from user input or elsewhere in the environment then the client should check (e.g. by calling getJITDylibByName) that the given name is not already in use.

briefdescription.para: Returns the default link order for this LLJIT instance.

detaileddescription.para: This link order will be appended to the link order of JITDylibs created by LLJIT's createJITDylib method.
